inputs.tracked: all three living characters for opcode 30; character slot 1 for opcode 31
inputs.scriptedRandResult: 10 for attribute checks; 25 for ability checks

castleObservation.opcode30: Every tracked character consumes its own draw, but all outcomes depend on c[t], where t is the active instruction slot. Negative attribute checks are additionally inverted once inside the attribute branch and again after the loop.
castleObservation.opcode31Index10: The selected living character remains tracked, exactly one Rand(25) draw is consumed, neither success nor failure XAP loads, and execution continues after the action.

playerFacingProblem: Opcode 30 can select or reject an entire party according to an unrelated action-slot character, and its attribute and ability forms disagree about negative selection. Scenario authors cannot reliably filter the characters whose own statistics they asked to test.

realmz2ChosenResult.opcode30: Evaluate each candidate's own attribute or trained ability, consume one draw per candidate in source order, and apply the authored negative sign exactly once as select-on-failure.
realmz2ChosenResult.opcode31Index10: Preserve the observed Castle behavior: ask for one living character, retain that identity, consume one Rand(25) draw, publish an explicit inert result, and continue without loading either XAP.
